turns.text: Make one image, aspect 9:16, from this exact description: Vertical 2:3 nighttime street photograph, slightly grainy, wide-angle, shot from standing height, looking diagonally down a narrow street. Show the front and right flank: elongated clear headlights with dark circular lenses, two large black oval bumper intakes, a small yellow hood badge, black windshield, white mirrors, sculpted side intake, silver wheels, and low-profile black tires. Dark parked cars recede beyond it. The left half contains a tall mustard-yellow plaster building with narrow dark windows, projecting horizontal ledges, pipes, and a black glass storefront reflecting vehicles. Palm trunks line illuminated shopfronts beneath a long gray facade; tiny people stand near the central entrance. Dark high-rises rise behind palm fronds into a deep blue-gray sky. At upper-right, a cropped curved facade has dark bands, pink-lit windows, and a bright amber streetlamp. Mixed harsh amber and cool white lighting creates deep shadows.
